description: This Scala source file defines the BatchedWriteAheadLog class, which is a wrapper for a WriteAheadLog that batches records before writing, handling aggregation and de-aggregation, and managing a background thread for writing batched records.

classes.name: BatchedWriteAheadLog
classes.description: A wrapper class for batching records before writing to an underlying WriteAheadLog, with background thread management and de-aggregation logic.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Adds a ByteBuffer record to the queue for batching and waits for the write to complete.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Not supported; throws UnsupportedOperationException because de-aggregation is required.

methods.name: readAll
methods.description: Reads and de-aggregates all logs from the wrapped log.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Delegates cleanup of old log files to the wrapped log.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the writer thread, fails pending promises, and closes the wrapped log.

methods.name: startBatchedWriterThread
methods.description: Starts a background thread that flushes batched records to the underlying log.

methods.name: flushRecords
methods.description: Writes all buffered records to the underlying log, handling sorting and promise fulfillment.
